meaning: 离开寻常路，探索冷僻之地
usageNote: 短语动词！说旅行或生活方式都能用，带点冒险感，跟朋友聊天超自然～

examples.en: We decided to get off the beaten track and explore tiny villages instead of tourist spots.
examples.zh: 我们决定走小众路线，去探索小村庄而不是景点。

examples.en: If you really want to experience local culture, get off the beaten track!
examples.zh: 如果你真想体验当地文化，就别走寻常路！
